main.description: An emoji reaction to a public item (a comment, post, or resolution), authored by a member from their own repo. One record per (reactor, subject, emoji); a member may add several different emojis to one item. Deleting the record removes the reaction (toggle). Reactions on private, org-internal items stay in the org store and are never records.

subject.description: The public record being reacted to.

emoji.description: A single emoji grapheme cluster (the reaction), e.g. an emoji that may itself be a ZWJ sequence.
